js: 'The Chat composer text box in both engines: never wider inside than it is (no sideways scroll, the WebKitGTK zoomed-placeholder bug), one line when empty with its hint over it, growing with its text and scrolling only past its cap, the hint rotating. html.tauri is set so the classic scrollbars of the app apply.Read-only apart from typing into the box (never sent); the last part docks the thread settings panel beside the thread the page reopens (its stored side state, removed after). Run:scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/chat-composer.json --block-writes --dsf 1.25 --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr>, or scripts/webkit-check.py --backend broadway --zoom 1.25 --drive scripts/drive/chat-composer.json --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr>.'

expect: (() => { const m = __cm(); return !!m && m.hint.text === 'Message…' && m.aria === 'Message' && m.hint.aria === 'true' && /Shift\+Enter/.test(m.title); })()
label: the first hint is Message…, the box is named Message, the hint is aria-hidden, the tooltip has the keys

expect: (() => { const hs = document.querySelectorAll('.composer-hint'); if (hs.length !== 1) return false; const cs = getComputedStyle(hs[0]); return cs.animationName === 'composer-hint' && cs.animationIterationCount === 'infinite' && cs.animationDuration === '5s' && cs.transitionDuration === '0s' && !hs[0].classList.contains('fading'); })()
label: one hint, its whole cycle one infinite 5 s CSS animation and no transition (WebKitGTK blanks an element for a frame when an opacity transition ends)

js: (() => { window.__rot = []; document.addEventListener('animationiteration', e => { if (e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('composer-hint')) window.__rot.push(e.target.textContent); }, true); return 'recording'; })()

label: the texts each iteration ended on, and the one shown now

expect: (() => { const H = ['Message…', 'Shift+Enter for a new line', 'Type # to add knowledge']; const seq = window.__rot.concat([__cm().hint.text]); if (window.__rot.length < 1) return false; return seq.every((t, k) => k === 0 || t === H[(H.indexOf(seq[k - 1]) + 1) % H.length]) && seq[0] === 'Message…'; })()
label: the hint moves on to the next one at each iteration of its animation, about every 5 s
